queries.sql:
WITH plan_data AS (
        SELECT COALESCE(m.plan_account_code, p.account_code) AS account_code, p.version_id, SUM(p.amount) AS amount
        FROM SNOWCONSO_RVG_DE.PUBLIC.V_PLAN_COMPOSED p
        LEFT JOIN SNOWCONSO_RVG_DE.PUBLIC.MAP_GL_TO_PLAN m ON p.account_code = m.gl_account_code
        WHERE p.version_id IN (1,2)
          AND p.period = '2026-09'
          
          
          
          
        GROUP BY COALESCE(m.plan_account_code, p.account_code), p.version_id
      )
      SELECT
        a.account_code,
        a.account_name,
        a.sort_order,
        a.sign_convention,
        pd.version_id,
        pd.amount
      FROM SNOWCONSO_RVG_DE.PUBLIC.DIM_ACCOUNT a
      JOIN plan_data pd ON pd.account_code = a.account_code
      WHERE a.account_type = 'IS'
        AND a.is_leaf = TRUE
      ORDER BY a.sort_order, pd.version_id
